detail.longDescription: Email received: Hey $name, Wanted to invite you to the Hanzo beta — we're looking for top open-source devs to help us shape the future of agentic AI. Join the beta: https://hanzo[.]app/beta I was checking out your open-source work on s3tools/s3cmd (especially what you've been building with Open-Source AI / ML) — really impressive engineering. We've been exploring autonomous decision systems and tool-use agents and would love your input. Let me know if you'd like to hop on a quick call, we're trying to speak with as many builders as we can: https://cal[.]com/antje-worring Warmly, Antje Worring Co-CEO, Hanzo AI GitHub: https://github[.]com/zooqueen LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin[.]com/in/antje-worring/ Hanzo AI, Inc. · 1 Ferry Building, Suite 201, San Francisco, CA 94111 Unsubscribe: https://hanzo[.]app/unsubscribe Reply 'stop' to opt out (I have not participated in the repo in question in over a decade)
